articleTitle: Blockchain for 5G Healthcare architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Technology does not stand still. Modern technologies are being introduced in all spheres of our life, including the healthcare system. In this article, we examined the prospects for introducing 5G technology and blockchain into the healthcare system. From a technical point of view, we analyzed the key weak points in the healthcare system, analyzed the capabilities and advantages of 5G, blockchain and related technologies, considered the benefits of their integration with the healthcare system. Based on the results obtained, we proposed a blockchain-based 5G healthcare architecture.

articleTitle: Forecasting Bitcoin Price Fluctuation by Twitter Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Bitcoin is one of the main phenomena in recent times together with other cryptocurrencies due to the redefinition of the money term and its price fluctuations. Moreover, scientists are increasingly recognizing Twitter's predictive power for a wide range of events, and particularly for financial markets. This article examines to what degree Bitcoin returns can be estimated using public opinion on Twitter. Using a sentiment analyzer on Bitcoin-related tweets and financial data, the Twitter sentiment was found to have predictive power for Bitcoin's results. Once again, our findings confirm the presence of a correlation between them. We observed 62.48% accuracy when making predictions based on bitcoin-related tweet sentiment and historical bitcoin price.

articleTitle: Wireless sensor networks based Agriculture 4.0: challenges and apportions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today, the penetration of digital technologies and wireless sensor networks (WSN) in every field is leading to a new direction of research. The use of wireless sensor networks in agriculture is also leading to many scientific advances and shortcomings. Experience from around the world shows that remote monitoring, control, monitoring and sales of agricultural products using IoT, sensors and means of communication are carried out using wireless sensors in the quality of work. The study of IoT and WSN, their advantages and disadvantages, allows us to consider the current penetration of agriculture, as well as its potential value in the future.

articleTitle: IoT based Centralized Double Stage Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The education sector plays an important role in the development of the country and has been relevant at all times. Especially in recent years, the development of information technology allows the use of previously impossible strategies. This article discusses problems in the education system and how to solve them based on Cloud infrastructure and Internet of Things [IoT] technologies. An algorithm has been developed for conducting a modern learning process called “IoT based Centralized Double Stage Education” which is a combination of modern technologies and classical teaching methods.

articleTitle: Detection of Roads Potholes using YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Road connectivity is most important for Developing Nations. A great challenge is to detect road damage which manually causes huge costs by putting different resources, such as instruments (technical devices). The need is to reduce the cost for governing bodies such that their inspection and damage road report should not be delayed. Road damage is of various types, which is an even regular process for the state to allocate budget in all means. The most efficient way which was seen by recent research is to utilize the latest object detection algorithm. A country like India where transportation is a lifeline for the economy. It has seen that most of the road damages arises due to potholes. Cost effective approach has to be considered to detect potholes. CNN has ability to extract the relevant features from image or video based datasets. In this paper, pothole image dataset annotated and trained using YOLOv4 and results were evaluated based on recall, preciosion and mAP. The model was validated with different set of images and videos based on potholes.

articleTitle: Object recognition method based on logical correcting functions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the logical method of object recognition and the construction of corrective functions. To construct a logical method for classifying objects, the method for constructing the optimal continuation of logical correcting functions is used. An algorithm for the optimal continuation of logical correcting functions is constructed and an estimate of the complexity of the constructed algorithm is calculated. A theorem is proved that the search algorithm for the minimum upper zero of a Boolean monotone function μ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</sub>(y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, ..., y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>) is in one-to-one correspondence with the problem of finding a minimal set of variables that is essential for a function F(x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, ..., x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>) that is not defined everywhere.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of non-stationary turbulent flow with double barrier based on two liquid turbulence model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the results of a numerical study of the flow structure in a flat channel with a double barrier. The calculations are based on solving a system of unsteady equations of two liquid models of Malikov turbulence. As a result, we studied the longitudinal velocity profiles in various sections of the channel, as well as the change in the friction coefficient and the pressure drop as a function of distance. For the difference approximation of the initial equations, the control volume method SIMPLE is used. In this case, the viscous terms were approximated by the central difference, and the second order accuracy scheme QUICK was used for convective terms. For the study, various Reynolds numbers were used and changes in the Reynolds number were studied for the influence of flow dynamics.

Author Keywords: flat channel with a double barrier

articleTitle: Accelerated Training for Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Handwritten character recognition (HCR) is one of the ongoing research field in Artificial Intelligence. The recognition of handwritten characters is based on pattern recognition and image processing. One of the most common machine learning methods for solving this problem is Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). To implement such tasks, a multilayer neural network is often used. CNN require as much data as possible to ensure high accuracy, while parallel processing can help us save time when neural network training. Such training time can be reduced by improving training operations using parallel computing technology and multi-core platforms. In this paper, exemplary parallelization of CNN training by dint of OpenMP technology and its libraries has been implemented. English alphabets were chosen as an experiment for the handwritten character recognition system, and CNN was used for its better accuracy. Each character data set contains 26 alphabets. That is, the image size of each character ranges from 16×16 to 256×256 pixels, and these pixels are taken as features for training the CNN. We analyzed how the speedup of CNN training depends on image size. Three multi-core processors with different specifications were chosen for the hardware implementation. The results show that the proposed parallel approach using OpenMP technology gives good acceleration, which reduces training time.

articleTitle: Logic Method of Finding Maximum Joint Subsystems of Systems of Boolean Equations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of finding the maximum joint subsystem of systems of Boolean equations is solved. An algorithm is proposed for finding the maximum upper zero of a monotone Boolean function. An algorithm is being developed for solving systems of Boolean equations based on a search for the maximum upper zero of the monotone functions of the algebra of logic.

articleTitle: Design of a Model For Disinfection Robot System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Following for hygiene and sanitation requirements have always been the most significant factor to stay healthy in human life. Proper cleaning and sanitation measures are one of the important ways to fight against various viruses. In recent years, the use of modern technology in sanitation has helped to fight against infectious diseases. One such modern technology is disinfection robot. Disinfection robots are increasingly used in all around the world. Use of these disinfection robots reduce the risk of infection, cost of traditional cleaning and disinfection, and most importantly acquires confidence and security of individuals. In this paper, we design a model for robot-disinfector. This robot is inspired on/from a technique, which consists of disinfecting places autonomously in order to save human life from infections. The main advantages of the designed robot are the novelty, multi-functionality, and the availability at an affordable cost.

articleTitle: On functions correcting the sets of incorrect algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we consider special classes of corrective functions, sets of heuristic algorithms that allow errors in the calculation of elementary properties. The article solves the problem of logical separability for the correcting functions of multivalued logic. For not everywhere defined functions, the simplest, in a sense, extensions to the entire set are constructed in such a way that these extensions are everywhere defined functions of many-valued logic. When solving a wide class of practical problems, the algorithms are often used that allow errors in calculation of elementary properties or refusals to solve problems. In such cases, several incorrect algorithms are usually applied to solve a single problem, and then a corrective function is constructed.

articleTitle: Analytical transformations in minimizing logical functions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Ahstract-The methods of logic algebra (Boolean algebra) are necessary for the study of a number of important problems in various science fields: biology, medicine, military science, automation, control, planning of experiments, wherever the quantitative relations between the values characterizing the processes under consideration are significant, and moreover, the logical dependencies connecting them are also essential. The Boolean function describes the functioning of the control system, and the implementation of its formula, in particular, the disjunctive normal form disjunctive normal form, gives a description of this system scheme, so that the nodes and elements of the scheme correspond to the terms and letters of the disjunctive normal form As a rule, the Boolean function has many different disjunctive normal form In mathematical logic, they are considered from a qualitative point of view. This article is devoted to analytical transforms in minimizing logical functions in the class of disjunctive normal forms.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Classifying Myocardial Infarction and Cardiomyopathy Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this study, for the first time, an automatic diagnostic algorithm for myocardial infarction (MI) and cardiomyopathy was developed based on ECG data obtained at different periods of time. ECG data were used taken from the ECG-VIEW II database. ECG data classification was done by the developed Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model. In order to determine the effectiveness of the proposed model, diseases with similar ECG manifestations (myocardial infarction and cardiomyopathy) were selected, which are still the most misdiagnosed among physicians today. Despite the less of data and dedicated symptoms and the similarity of symptoms of the disease on the ECG, the accuracy of the network test result became high, 91,1%. The conclusion is that with a larger database and more features, or with 12 channel ECG database it is possible to further increase the accuracy of the network, as well as increase capability of the network to differentiate other diseases. Moreover, most importantly, this model has the ability to increase the diagnostic accuracy of 1-channel smartphone ECG devices.

articleTitle: Using Different Features of Signal in EMG Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Separation of signal features is the separation of the necessary data by selecting the desired parts of the signal. In this research, a comparative analysis of the classification based on some significant time domain and frequency domain features of the EMG signal is presented. In our research, it became clear analyzed that in the individual and combination application of features in the time and frequency domains, the features in the time domain had a higher rate than the features in the frequency domain with their speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Development of an IP network model based on PBX Asterisk on the Opnet Modeler simulation package
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This publication is devoted to the research and development of an IP network model is based on IP PBX Asterisk in the Opnet Modeler simulation package. The IP PBX Asterisk software solution is used for voice telephony. The hardware part of the researching network is based on Cisco network equipment. A SIP server configured to transmit multimedia traffic is selected as the server for transmitting information for IP PBX Asterisk. A brief review of sources [1]-[4] dedicated to the use of IP PBX Asterisk on the Opnet Modeler software package is conducted. The problems related to the use of separate simulations for different types of traffic and comparing their results with each other to determine the characteristics of network delays, bandwidth between network nodes, and others are relevant (actual). Simulation in such a network is based on the two scenarios. The simulation results in the above scenarios showed that the speed of packets passing through the entire network and memory usage in each of the scenarios remains a constant value. Minimal delays are observed when transmitting Unicast traffic during videoconferencing and even during VoIP traffic.

articleTitle: About The Dodges Plans of the Continuous Selective Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The mathematical methods of the statistical acceptance control (SAC) are one of the important areas of applied mathematical statistics. The main tasks of SAC are the problems of evaluating of the quality of industrial production. The growing requirement to quality of production promoted development of a number of the plans of SAC. In this paper the Dodge's plan of the continuous selective control is considered.

articleTitle: Integrated Solutions Energy Harvesting Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article the actual issue of the use of ambient energy for wireless sensor networks sensor supply and maintenance-free. A number of electronic components for the development of devices powered by the energy of the environment are considered. The main directions of development in the field of energy-saving devices.

articleTitle: Algebraic Cryptanalysis of O'zDSt 1105:2009 Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we examine algebraic attacks on the O'zDSt 1105:2009. We begin with a brief review of the meaning of algebraic cryptanalysis, followed by an algebraic cryptanalysis of O'zDSt 1105:2009. Primarily O'zDSt 1105:2009 encryption algorithm is decomposed and each transformation in it is algebraic described separately. Then input and output of each transformation are expressed with other transformation, encryption key, plaintext and cipher text. Created equations, unknowns on it and degree of unknowns are analyzed, and then overall result is given. Based on experimental results, it is impossible to save all system of equations that describes all transformations in O'zDSt 1105:2009 standard. Because, this task requires 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">73</sup> bytes for the second round. For this reason, it is advisable to evaluate the parameters of the system of algebraic equations, representing the O'zDSt 1105:2009 standard, theoretically.

articleTitle: Analog Sensing and Leap Motion Integrated Remote Controller for Search and Rescue Robot System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the age of modern technological capabilities, robotic systems play a vital role in making our lives more comfortable. Robotic systems are becoming an essential part of human life due to their efficiency, multi-functionality, and high performance. In recent years, search and rescue robot systems are used tremendously for helping to rescuers in a natural disaster. Every year, millions of people are affected by disasters in different parts of the world. Disasters can be manmade or natural, such as building collapse, earthquakes, avalanches, volcanic activity, wildfires, and floods, etc. This witnesses the importance of sensor-based search and rescue robot systems in the emergency and also disaster management field. A variety of sensing and wireless technologies are used for remote and vision controlling in the emergency field. The use of these sensing and wireless technologies, the rescuers instead of going inside in the disaster area, can control the robot systems remotely when calamity occurs. A remote controller is used in the remote control of modern robotic systems. In this paper, we design an analog sensing and Leap Motion integrated remote controller for search and rescue robot system. The controller consists of an Arduino Mega Pro MINI, joystick module, Leap Motion controller, radio module, USB hub, potentiometer, power switch, button, USB type B female, Ii-on battery and Ii-on charger. The remote controller has the ability to help the rescuers to remote control in the disaster area from far away. The rescuers also could save their lives by using this remote controller. The main objective of this paper is to design a multi-functional and easy to control remote controller for search and rescue robot system.

articleTitle: Differential Collisions in SHA-1
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In paper highlights of hash functions differential cryptanalysis on an example of algorithm SHA-1 are considered. The technique of carrying out of the differential analysis of SHA-1 hash function and other hash functions having a similar structure is offered.

articleTitle: Satellite image formation and preprocessing methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper gives a conceptual and practical introduction to the field of satellite image formation and preprocessing. In particular, the process of satellite image generation is discussed going through each step of its lifecycle. A special explanatory emphasis is given to the process of remote sensing and further mapping and fusion of satellite imagery within acquired segments of electromagnetic spectrum. Moreover, methods of satellite imagery retrieval have been practically demonstrated. The satellite imagery data has been extracted from Sentinel 2 dataset and analyzed with Python language image processing libraries.

articleTitle: Results of A Computational Experiment And Analysis of The Time Characteristics Of A Multiservice Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the results of a computational experiment and analysis of time characteristics of a multiservice communication network (MCN). The experiment was carried out at various values of the coefficient of readiness Kg and the congestion ρ of the MCN. The dependences of the probability of timely service request from the load of the MCN at different of the coefficient of readiness Kg are obtained. The results of a computational experiment to determine the minimum value of the objective function that ensures the fulfillment of the requirements for the reliability of the MCN are presented in the form of graphs.

articleTitle: A computational algorithm for calculating the effect of the electromagnetic fields to thin complex configured plates
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A nonlinear mathematical model of a flexible magneto-elastic plate (in motion subject to forces) is developed on the Lagrange principle. A computational algorithm is presented to estimate the geometry of magnetic plates. The algorithm is based on R-Function and Galerkin methods. These methods are used to develop a computational scheme. The cases of simple and complex structures of magneto-elastic flexible plates are considered and solutions are obtained under specific boundary conditions. These conditions are defined with some concrete requirements of engineering.

articleTitle: Model and device for measuring the parameters of the technological radio communication network in the “on-line” mode in the signaling and communication laboratory wagon
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The goal of this work is the development of CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access) 450 mobile communications for installation and connection of a CDMA terminal apparatus to a fax machine and the operation of a DTU-450S modem. To achieve this goal, we considered the classification of radio stations, simplex linear radio networks PRS-S and duplex radio networks PRS-SZ, expansion of CDMA wireless access services, determined the characteristics of WLL CDMA radio access equipment, analyzed the energy balance of the uplink radio line, determined the features of the introduction of CDMA 450 equipment on iron Uzbekistan's railway, the installation of connecting the CDMA terminal apparatus to the facsimile apparatus was developed, the process of measuring and processing data by the wagon-laboratory was developed, the construction and implementation of the CDMA 450 MHz network were carried out, and recommendations were made for the modernization of the organization of the CDMA 450 MHz communication network on the <; <; Distance alarm and communication>> -1 section.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The development of fast-growing blockchain technology is encourages for the review and rethinking of many of the fundamental facts of our traditional education systems. As experience shows, the blockchain increases security and accessibility tremendously, such concepts as confidence, assessment and identity, currently doesn't satisfy users desires and there a reasonable necessity for the improvements. In this paper, we will consider providing of new methods for the database system in education, implementing the new blockchain technology in education since a new scheme can increase transparency and security in the education system.

articleTitle: Optimization of identification of micro-objects based on the use of characteristics of images and properties of models
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A methodology has been developed for optimizing the identification of micro-objects based on the use of dynamic models, neural networks (NN) of various topologies, synthesis of mechanisms for extracting statistical, dynamic, specific characteristics of images, selecting and segmenting a contour, selecting reference points, reducing redundant points, and setting variables. Identification mechanisms based on statistical relationships, many points and dynamics of change, formalization of the coordinate matrices of distorted points, approximations during the deformation of a sequence of segments of stationary contour sections are proposed. A comparative analysis of the effectiveness of tools for preliminary image processing, recognition, and classification on the examples of pollen grains is carried out. Modified component circuits, adaptive learning algorithms of the Kohonen NN. A software package for visualization, recognition, classification of images of pollen grains was developed, a hybrid identification model was implemented with non-linear effects of factors and conditions of a priori insufficiency and uncertainty of parameters. The implemented software package is based on a three-layer NN of forwarding and backward propagation, learning algorithms with and without a teacher, a modified Kohonen network with vector quantization, clustering, segmentation, and the formation of a “sliding window”. The mechanisms of image identification in the presence of “noise”, error filtering, and neural network approximation of the contour curve of micro-objects images are investigated.

articleTitle: Calculation of orthotropic flexible plates with complex configuration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the calculation of orthotropic flexible plates with a complex configuration by the R-function method. In particular, the equations of condition of geometrically nonlinear anisotropic flexible plates introduced on the basis of the Lagrange principle are given, as well as the relations for moments and forces. These equations are solved under appropriate boundary conditions depending on the methods of fixing the edges of the plate in question. A computational algorithm for linearization of nonlinear systems of differential equations has been developed, and here we present the simplest method of linearization obtained by using the method of successive approximations for calculating orthotropic flexible plates with complex configurations using the Bubnov-Galerkin variational method and the structural method of R-functions.

articleTitle: Research of the influence of reliability on qualitative parameters of the transport subnet of the infocommunication system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article proposes a model of research the influence of reliability parameters of the transport subnet of an infocommunication system on qualitative network parameters, based on queuing theory, shows the degree of influence of the availability coefficient on the values of the probability of uptime and the probability of loss of message packets of external traffic.

articleTitle: Turkic Morpheme Web Portal as a Platform for Turkology Research
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper describes the development of Turkic Morpheme web portal, a toolkit that takes into account core features of Turkic languages and meets the requirements for research activities in computational linguistics and typology. This portal was created on the basis of the structural-parametric functional model of the Turkic morpheme and contains special linguistic databases that describe the categories of Turkic languages at different levels: morphological, syntactic, and semantic. The portal can also be used in educational process as a reference system for Turkic languages.

articleTitle: Application of the Aho-Corasick algorithm to create a network intrusion detection system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: One of the main goals of studying pattern matching techniques is their significant role in real-world applications, such as the intrusion detection systems branch. The purpose of the network attack detection systems NIDS is to protect the infocommunication network from unauthorized access. This article provides an analysis of the exact match and fuzzy matching methods, and discusses a new implementation of the classic Aho-Korasik pattern matching algorithm at the hardware level. The proposed approach to the implementation of the Aho-Korasik algorithm can make it possible to ensure the efficient use of resources, such as memory and energy.

articleTitle: Approaches to Handwriting Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper describes the basic ideas and methods to solve subproblems such as Sellisele algorithm, Neural network structures, Invariant numbers and their modifications used in modern recognition systems. The main objective of the research is the development of software complexes of recognition of text data on the basis of genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Mathematical model for optimal siting of the industrial plants
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Research, prediction and monitoring of air vmasses in the atmosphere of industrial regions are described in the paper. A mathematical model, an effective numerical algorithm based on the method of splitting into physical processes and analysis of numerical calculations on a computer are developed.

articleTitle: Design Of A Model For Multi-Parametric Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Health-related issues have been regarded as one of the major problems which the government and the public have to pay attention to. Technological advances in mobile and electronic healthcare are revolutionizing the involvement of both doctors and patients in the modern healthcare system by extending the capabilities of real-time health monitoring systems. Modern healthcare, with its technological capabilities, provides great convenience to patients. Remote real-time monitoring of patient's health is also one of the great achievements of modern healthcare. This paper presents the design of a model for multi-parametric health monitoring system based on sensors. This system is beneficial through its innovative concept, its simplicity, and multi functionality.

articleTitle: A Symptom Selection Algorithm Based on Classification Errors
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper the issues like preprocessing of ischemic heart disease data and optimization of feature space are discussed and solved. Here an algorithm for selection a set of information features based on classification error are proposed. Using this algorithm was obtain the set of most informative symptoms for three class of ischemic heart disease: “Progressive angina pectoris”, “Acute myocardial infarction” and “Arrhythmic form”.

articleTitle: Making algorithm of improved key generation model and software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper is devoted methods for generating keys for cryptographic algorithms. Hash algorithms were analysed and learned linear and nonlinear. It was made up improved key generation algorithm and software.

articleTitle: Fiber optic gyroscope and accelerometer application in aircraft inertial system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Due to increasing of accuracy requirements for the aircraft position determining by the using of autonomous navigation systems, the task of inertial system development becomes more and more urgent. In this paper considered the possibility of using of fiber optic gyroscope based on Sagnac effect and fiber optic accelerometers in Aircraft inertial systems. As shown in the paper, fiber optic gyroscopes allows small angles measurement more accurate than currently used ring laser gyroscopes. In addition these gyroscopes are chipper, more compact and reliable. Also using of fiber optic accelerometers in aircraft inertial system advantages are shown.

articleTitle: Methods for Calculating Route Metrics in Data Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes the characteristics of the routing protocols used in the data transmission network and their impact on network performance. Methods for calculating route metrics are given, which characterize the routing algorithm in detail.

articleTitle: Analysis of Information Security Evaluation Models in the Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, we examined the confidence matrix, analyzed and solved the issues of assessing the risks of information security of cloud computing using the analytical method and modeling method.

articleTitle: Selection of Construction Materials on Fuzzy Inference Rules
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Properties and material selection are an important factor in the design of an object. When choosing a material, it is necessary to take into account not only technical and economic factors but also environmental factors should be taken into account. The article dedicated a method for optimizing the choice of building material using a nonlinear rule derivation to the algorithm and nonlinear regression equations. This article presents the choice of parameters based on a fuzzy () inference system and a nonnegative regression model, and solving a system of linear equations by optimizing this parameter.

articleTitle: Development of Control Models of Non-Stationary Systems in Limited Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This study examines the issue of optimization of management models, which mainly focuses on the prediction of economic indicators and management based on neural models. Non-stationary processes, reflecting technological, economic, social, biological, physical phenomena, are characterized by quantitative and qualitative characteristics, which are characterized by abrupt, evolving development and regulation of parameters over time. Modeling of non-stationary processes in the general case can be carried out using traditional mathematical methods, but today a promising area of research is the use of modern methods of intelligent data processing, one of the brightest representatives of which are neural network technologies. Therefore, it is important to improve management models to implement the above tasks.

articleTitle: Joint Application of A Runiing Wave Amplifier and Acousto-Optical Configurable Filter for Linearization of The Passage Spectral Characteristics of Focles
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the issues of linearization of the spectral characteristics of fiber-optic transmission systems (FOTS) information. It has been found that the combined use of an amplifier, such as a runing wave amplifier (RWA), and an acousto-optic tunable filter (AOTF) allows linearizing the transmission spectral characteristics of a FOTS. Linearization results in a reduction of distortion of the optical spectrum and can increase the rate of transmitted information.

articleTitle: Methods for Increasing and Assessing Reliability of Medical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study of methods to increase and evaluate the reliability of medical equipment. The failure of medical equipment can give false testimony during diagnosis and can affect the health of a person, both the patient and the doctor. Depending on the possible consequences of failure during operation, medical devices are divided into groups, which must be taken into account when determining reliability. The basic provisions of reliability are analyzed. Many medical devices are designed based on microprocessor systems, namely microcontrollers. In this regard, issues of increasing and assessing reliability are considered on the example of an electroencephalograph (EEG). To increase the reliability of the device, it is proposed to duplicate its main component - a microcontroller. The methods of increasing and calculating the reliability of the EEG are given. A method and algorithm and a Markov model for assessing the reliability of an EEG microcontroller are proposed and realized in the C++ programming system. In this case, when choosing a method for calculating the reliability parameters, it is necessary to take into account many factors that affect the proctration and operation of the device. The developed algorithm makes it possible to assess the reliability of medical equipment and microprocessor control systems at the design stage, therefore it is recommended for use by developers.

articleTitle: Proper QCA Five-input Majority Gate to Design Optimal Complex Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes and compares previously published five input majority gates. These designs do not give good results in physical properties. Therefore, a low-power five-input majority gate is proposed in a single layer, which uses a minimum number of cells and a smaller area, and achieves a highly polarized output compared to previous designs. Structural and power dissipation analysis is conducted to assess implementation. The results of the analysis show that this structure works well compared to existing designs. The QCADesiner tool is used to verify the simulation results of the proposed design, and the QCAPro tool is used to evaluate the power dissipation of all considered designs.

articleTitle: Methods of automation of the employment process on the basis of ratings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is necessary to create an online communication environment between the employer and the specialist on the basis of digital technologies, that is, each specialist should have a high-quality workplace based on the formation of a rating of knowledge and achievements in the learning process. This paper discusses automation models for determining the ranking and employment of university students on the basis of academic performance, scientific and creative achievements, spiritual and educational achievements. The question of determining the rating of each student, the rating of a university and the ranking of university areas on the basis of mastering subjects, personal achievements, organizing spiritual and educational activities and participating in it was studied. Based on the solution to this problem, it will be possible to satisfy the demand for high-quality personnel and control employment. To automate the evaluation process, its mathematical modeling were carried and the parameters of the mathematical model were determined. Based on the rating, an infological and general model of a system for monitoring employment and labor relations of industry potential for employers has been developed.

articleTitle: Principles of Adaptation in Protecting Corporate Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the work systematized the basic principles of adaptation used in information protection systems, a methodology for constructing security systems based on an adaptive approach is presented; methodology for evaluating the effectiveness of an adaptive defense system. Examples of incorporating intelligent adaptive security systems into corporate governance are given.

articleTitle: Analysis of machine learning methods for filtering spam messages in email services
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper describes the advantages and disadvantages of methods for detecting and protecting against spam messages in electronic mail services, considers the classification of spam messages and the Naive Bayes spam filter used to classify spam messages. The characteristics and effectiveness of spam filters based on machine learning methods are analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Signal Processors based on Methods of Spline-Functions for One-Dimensional Signals Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the issues of using digital signal processors for processing and smoothing one-dimensional signals and experimental data. The use of cubic basic splines and smoothing splines for approximating signals is proposed. VisualDSP++ simulator was used as a medium for modelling of signal processing processes, as well as development and debugging of programs for digital signal processors. This environment includes an easy-to-use assembler, a C/C++ compiler, and a C/C++ executable function library that includes mathematical and DSP functions. A key feature of the simulator is the effectiveness of code written in C/C++. The results of processing and smoothing of one-dimensional seismic signals and experimental data obtained as a result of magnetic prospecting are also presented.

articleTitle: On the Basic Method for Solving the Problem of Synthesizing Access Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for structural synthesis of an access control system in computer systems, based on the use of the principles of the process of evolutionary construction of systems, allowing for a controlled multi-criteria synthesis of an access control system. It is proposed to use genetic optimization algorithms as a basic method for solving the problem of synthesizing access control systems. The classification of genetic optimization algorithms is carried out according to the characteristics most essential for access control systems, and particular methods of solving the problem of synthesis of access control systems corresponding to various classes of genetic algorithms are considered.

articleTitle: Generation and Distribution Secret Encryption Keys with Parameter
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: this article describes a new way to generate and distribute secret encryption keys, in which the processes of generating a public key and formicating a secret encryption key are performed in algebra with a parameter, the secrecy of which provides increased durability of the key.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy consumption of wireless sensor network nodes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of increasing energy consumption and energy efficiency of wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes. The main factor influencing the likelihood of a sensor network malfunction is the limited power consumption resource of the node. The method of calculating the energy consumption of nodes and the service life of their supply elements is given. The oscillogram of the current consumption depending on the stage of processing the request at the sensor node also shows the cases of current consumption when using a neural network in the sensor node. The energy consumption of the sensor node has been considered separately using conventional and neural networks.

articleTitle: Enterprise Systems Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers and analyzes the main factors affecting the integration of these systems in the enterprise. Possible solutions necessary for the tasks of data integration between different systems are presented. This article describes the main approaches to the integration of information systems, which in turn demonstrate possible ways to solve various problems of enterprises associated with the need to organize the interaction of heterogeneous systems.

articleTitle: Evaluating the effectiveness of a software-defined cloud data center with a distributed structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is proposed by combining autonomous data centers using a software-defined networking to create an infrastructure of a single distributed cloud data center with centralized management of distributed resources, the formation of such a system is carried out by successively solving the problems of building a K-connected network topology, creating and placing virtual resources and providing resources using the directed method random search, modeling shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Real Time Railway Monitoring System suitable for Multi-View Object based on Sensor Stream Data Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A glance on the developments of the railway safety system reveals that the consistent research has made a remarkable progresses finding and devising techniques to alleviate noise and vibration resulting from wheel and rail interaction alongside the railway track infrastructure. Internet of Things (IOT) and AI has an immense potential to provide safety and operation efficiency in railroad bridges, tunnels and overall railway infrastructures. In this research paper, we propose a railway safety monitoring application based on the Internet of Things (IOT) to deliver a real-time assessment of the state of safety and efficiency in railroad bridges, tunnels and welfare of residence areas surrounding the railroad infrastructure.

articleTitle: An ECG Processing and Analysis Technique Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of processing and analysis of the main indicators of an electrocardiogram (ECG) based on neural networks. An algorithm for decision support for an ECG analysis using a neural network for training vector quantization is proposed. For the study, the following functions were selected such as the duration of the QRS complex, the RR interval, the amplitude of the R wave and the change in the slope of the ST segment and the heart rate. These five functions are the five inputs to the neural network learning vector quantization. At the same time, methods of preliminary processing and analysis of the extraction of ECG functions based on the obtained ECG database of a medical institution in MATLAB are given. A generalized algorithm for the generated LVQ network and the architecture of the LVQ neural network created using MATLAB are proposed. A method for training a neural network to classify an ECG signal based on the training data obtained in the process of extracting signs - 5 inputs (RR interval, R wave amplitude, QRS complex duration, ST segment slope, heart rate) into one of five classes (bradycardia, tachycardia, premature ventricular contraction (PVC), myocardial infarction or in the absence of disease class) is proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Research Multiphases Signal Transducers of Power Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Presented model and results of research of transforming processes, which flowing in converting elements and circuits of transducer of primary multiphases electrical current to secondary signal. Modeling and research of main characteristics of primary measure transducers of multiphase primary electrical currents of power energy to secondary signal based to graph model with high formalized, effectively and digital-based cloud computing technology.

articleTitle: Binding Energy of a One-Dimensional Exciton in a Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Considered one-dimensional exciton state in a size-quantized semiconductor wire in a uniform magnetic field. Obtained mathematical model of the effective Coulomb potential, the interaction of an electron and a hole, and the Schrodinger equation for determining the binding energy. The dependences of the effective potential and the binding energy of an exciton on the magnetic field are numerically investigated for various values of the parameter, which depends on the ratio of the radius and the type of wire materials.

Author Keywords: mathematical model of the effective Coulomb potential

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of transition processes due to a change in gas consumption at the ends of the inclined section of the gas
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents a solution to the problem of the gas-dynamic state of an elementary section of a gas pipeline with variable input and output mass gas outflows, which is obtained by the method of separation of variables. The quasi-one-dimensional mathematical model of pipeline transport of real gas takes into account factors such as friction, gravity and the local component of the inertia of the gas. By introducing the mass flow rate and averaging the velocity in the quadratic law of resistance, the autonomous equations of the telegraph equation with respect to pressure and mass flow are compiled from a system of equations. Taking into account possible abrupt changes of the unknowns in time and distance, the solution is sought in the form of functional series. The demonstrativeness of this method lies in the fact that the perturbation frequencies relevant to the parabolic and hyperbolic types of equations and the intermediate variant are distinguished. A description is given of a general method for solving the problem when temporary changes in the gas mass flow rate are set at the ends of the section. The exact solutions of mass flow rate and hydrostatic pressure are obtained for the case of a spasmodic change in mass flow rate at the boundaries of the site with a constant slope from the horizon. Numerical results related to the case of instantaneous closure of the output section of a linear section are presented. The results of the work are useful for assessing the energy intensity and reliability of gas pipelines in conditions of large diameters, high working pressures, and also when the gas pipeline is laid along a relief line.

articleTitle: Photon absorption efficiency for Crystalline Silicon Solar Cell and Optimizing the thickness of the absorptive layer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Highly efficient Crystalline silicon (c-Si) solar cells increasingly feature complex electron and hole contacts aimed at minimizing losses of electron-hole pair combination. Here, we are simulating the fate of the photon using an arbitrary variable and developing an algorithm. As the fate of the photon is a function of the absorption coefficient of the material, refractive index and thickness of the absorption layer, In this paper we developed an algorithm based on Monte Carlo Ray Tracing to track the photon packets and propose an accurate yet simple method to optimize the thickness of the absorption layer for the maximum absorption of electron-hole pair.

articleTitle: Analysis and improvement of the methods used for performance assessing of 4G network with NB-IoT technology for three scenarios of spectrum use in the 900 MHz range
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article provides an example of a simulation developed in the U-Net Planning Tool environment for researching the application of the effectiveness of various scenarios of using the radio frequency spectrum in 4G mobile networks in the provision of Internet of Things services. A new methodology for testing the NB-IoT network presented, as well as presented conclusions and recommendations for choosing the most optimal scenario for deploying NB-IoT based on the obtained data.

articleTitle: Methods and intelligent mechanisms for constructing cyberattack detection components on distance-learning systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper is suggested the methods for the development of intelligent adaptive cyber defense systems and cybersecurity management mechanisms based on intelligent agents that can increase the security of the system to the required level on distance-learning systems.

articleTitle: Experiments on Multiwavelength Selective Crossbar Switches
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We present the summary of experimental results on multiple generations of multiwavelength selective crossbar switches designed and fabricated in silicon photonics platform as a part of AIM Photonics. We report CW measurements of 8 × 4 and 4 × 4 switches. The latest generation of the switch improved worst case path losses by 75 % as compared with the first. We also demonstrate error free transmission in the presence of incoherent crosstalk with multiple crosstalk sources with 40 Gbps non return to zero signal and 111 Gbps four-level pulse amplitude modulation (PAM-4) transmission with hard decision forward error correction limit.

articleTitle: Internet of things architecture and security challenges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper focuses on security issues on the Internet of things. It provides recommendations on the architecture of the Internet of things, security issues at the surface, attacks, and protection against them.

articleTitle: Modeling and research signals conversion proceses of multhipase power measure and control devices
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Without further processing the measurement and control results, the data displayed on the displays shall reflect all the characteristics of the electrical energy that determine whether or not these characteristics meet the requirements for the time interval obtained. This range includes analytical calculations of the measured parameters and graphical results based on their dynamic, static classifications. For them, an important functional feature of multiphase power measure and control devices, that determines the structural and climatic requirements, element base, power supply system, ability to store and transmit results is the type of measurement and control - continuous or periodic.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy Control Algorithm of Dynamic Objects with Uncertainty of a Priori Information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the issues of creating a neuro-fuzzy control algorithm for dynamic objects with the uncertainty of a priori information. A mathematical model of dynamic objects in the state space in the conditions of fuzzy initial information is proposed. A neuro-fuzzy algorithm for controlling technological objects based on a dynamic model with robust properties is synthesized.

articleTitle: Synthesis of an Automatic Control System with Pulse-width Modulation According to the Speed Criterion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problems of synthesizing optimal control actions in systems with pulse-width modulation encounters difficulties associated with the obtained sufficiently simple expressions, which gives a correct solution, intended use of the results in control problems for complex discrete dynamic objects in real time. The use of existing methods does not give acceptable results even with the use of modern computing facilities, due to the cumbersomeness of the results obtained, as well as the difficulty of ensuring the physical realizability of the expressions obtained. In this regard, the development of machine-oriented methods for the synthesis of optimal control actions in a system with pulse-width modulation, the use of which does not require a large mathematical calculation, and having a large degree of formalization, is undoubtedly an urgent scientific and technical problem. This task becomes especially relevant with the widespread use of microcontrollers in the control of technological processes. When synthesizing optimal control actions in systems with pulse-width modulation, difficulties arise in obtaining sufficiently simple equations, the solution of which can give incorrect and unacceptable results for further use. In addition, the use of existing methods for solving such problems, even with the use of modern computer technology, cannot guarantee obtaining acceptable results. Therefore, the development of machine-oriented methods for the synthesis of control actions in systems with pulse-width modulation, the application does not require a lot of mathematical training, making intuitive decisions in the implementation of various kinds of assumptions and having a sufficiently large degree of formality, undoubtedly, is an urgent task.

Author Keywords: interpretation of the dynamics of impulse systems

articleTitle: Implementation of intercorporate correlation of information security messages and audits
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper discusses open information and communication systems that can provide access to certain information through various Internet applications. Also, in the paper is described the scheme of work of intercorporate correlation which each information security monitoring system and audit directly exchange reputation information with all other and database is dynamically updated and does not contain sender IDs.

articleTitle: Method of Reduction of the Equation of Mathematical Model of Regulatory Mechanisms of Cardiac Activity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, a mathematical model has been developed in the form of a system of functional -differential equations with a delay argument for studying the regulatory mechanisms of cardiac activity. To simplify the qualitative and quantitative analysis, a reduction method was applied, as a result of which the system of functional differential equations was reduced to a simplified form as a single equation. The results of a qualitative analysis of the mathematical model are presented. On base of the results, the equilibrium points of the mathematical model are determined and the results of testing their stability are presented.

articleTitle: A Simple Motion Differential Game of Evasion from Many Pursuers with Integral and Different Type of Constraints in Critical Case
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper we study a simple motion evasion differential game many players in critical case with integral and different type of constraints. Considered free cases; 1) maximal resources of the evader more then summa maximal resources of pursuers; 2) maximal resources of the evader equal summa maximal resources of pursuers; 3) different types of constraints on controls. In all case proof of theorem evasion from many pursuers. To construct the evasion control, the initial positions, current states and controls of pursuers are used.

Author Keywords: integral and different type of constraints

articleTitle: Multi-Agent System for Assessing the Status of Weakly Formalized Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article discussed a multi-agent system for assessing the status of poorly formalized system. Poorly formalized system consists of multiple agents interacting in a distributed mode. Achievement in the field of distributed artificial intelligence, the theory of intelligent agent technology and soft computing, makes it possible for these agents as components of complex systems interact to cooperate, compete with each other and coordinate their actions in order to develop a global behavior, poorly formalized systems.

articleTitle: The Software Solution of the Overload Capacity of a Three-Phase Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article devoted to make characteristic of electrical engine on base of program platform PASCAL. In this paper consider and construct the mechanical characteristic of an induction motor, and calculate the main parameters of the electric motor. In the program compiled for this task, the voltage of loss of the starting ability with the rated torque on the shaft is calculated, the relationship between the slip and the motor torque is determined.

articleTitle: Study of the Method of Compact Testing of Technical Means of Data Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the issues of assessing the reliability of control of compact testing of technical means of data transmission networks by the analytical method and simulation. We have completed the life cycle of the technical means of data transmission systems and the ways of their enhanced reliability. Methods of calculation and determination of signatures for signature analysis in the diagnosis of microprocessor devices are considered. The analysis of tasks and classification of systems of technical diagnostics of microprocessor devices of data transmission systems is carried out. The analysis of modern microprocessor devices of data transmission systems as an object of control and diagnostics necessary for the choice of characteristics of signature analysis methods is made, that the main documents of signature analysis are dictionaries of the reference signatures. It is shown that the main document of signature analysis is the dictionary of reference signatures. A comparative analysis of the methods of calculation and determination of reference signatures used in the diagnosis of microprocessor devices has been performed.

articleTitle: Influence of Weather Conditions on Disconnection in Open Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A formalized algorithm is presented and a calculation of communication breakdown in atmospheric optical transmission systems is made depending on the intensity of precipitation based on published statistically processed experimental data on the quantitative characteristics of the distribution of raindrops by size. Based on the meteorological data received from the weather stations of the Karshi airport, statistics on the minimum visibility range have been compiled. Based on these data, the integral distribution functions of the minimum visibility range and kilometric attenuation necessary to take into account the climatic features of a given geographic area, when designing open optical transmission systems, were calculated.

articleTitle: Synthesis of an Automatic Control System of a Multidimensional Dynamic Object Under Information Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the synthesis the automated control system (ACS) multidimensional object with incomplete information about the object. To select the structure and parameters of regulators provided the use of the criterion of acceptable quality and principle of guaranteed dynamics. In this initial data and engineering requirements for the quality of regulation and the dynamic properties of an object. Sought for control law includes both the desired state of the object, the speed of change of the vector components of the control errors and system requirements. The proposed approach is simple realization on the real object, because expression for the control is obtained in an analytical form.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the reliability of transmitted messages over concatenated communication lines using simulation modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: To assess the reliability of transmitted messages over concatenated communication lines, a model for simulating the process of errors in communication channels is included in the network simulation model. As a result of the experiments, a histogram of the distribution of errors over the communication network channels was constructed, which in addition to the reliability indicator, allows one to clearly judge the noise immunity of individual communication channels.

articleTitle: A Research on Big Data Analytics in Healthcare Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Big Data has changed the way we manage, analyze and leverage data in any industry. One of the most promising areas where it can be applied to make a change is healthcare. Healthcare analytics have the potential to reduce costs of treatment, predict outbreaks of epidemics, avoid preventable diseases and improve the quality of life in general. Average human lifespan is increasing along world population, which poses new challenges to today's treatment delivery methods. In this article, we would like to address the need of big data in health care industry, big data analytics advantages, big data applications and so on.

articleTitle: PDF Based Node Localization In Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today increasing the energy consumption efficiency of nodes in wireless sensor networks (WSN) is one of the main problems of the network. The issue of energy saving in wireless sensor networks requires great attention. One of the main ways to save energy is the rational placement of sensor nodes in the network area, which in turn allows to balance the flow of energy, throughout the network and prevent the appearance of “energy holes”. In this paper, the viability of the network is analyzed. The parameter density of the sensor node that affects network viability has been identified. In order to meet the energy balancing requirement, a mathematical model of node placement based on the probability density function (PDF) developed.

articleTitle: Impact of Tashkent Architecture Features on Weakening of a Field Strength Levels of Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Knowing the levels of the distribution patterns of the field strength in urban environments can correctly determine the number of base stations required to provide high-quality mobile communication. High quality of mobile communications, in turn, creates the best conditions for a quick payback on the development of a mobile network. In this article, there are derived the expressions for calculating the attenuation of the field strength of mobile communication stations in the megapolis on the example of the capital of Uzbekistan - Tashkent in the frequency bands 900 and 1800 MHz. Expressions allow to take into account factors that affect the signal attenuation in detail.

articleTitle: Increasing The Efficiency Of Diagnosing Microprocessor Devices Based On Multichannel Signal Analysis Means
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The issues of analytical and simulation-based evaluation of reliability of controlling the multi-channel signature diagnostic method are described in this paper. The analysis of tasks and classification of systems of technical diagnostics of microprocessor devices of data transmission systems is carried out. The analysis of modern microprocessor devices of data transmission systems as an object of control and diagnostics necessary for the choice of characteristics of signature analysis methods is made, that the main documents of signature analysis are dictionaries of the reference signatures. Methods of calculation and determination of signatures for signature analysis in the diagnosis of microprocessor devices are considered. It is shown that the main document of signature analysis is the dictionary of reference signatures. A comparative analysis of the methods of calculation and determination of reference signatures used in the diagnosis of microprocessor devices has been performed. Algarymms and simulation programs for one and multi-channel signature methods for automating the determination of reference signatures for multi-output microprocessor devices have been developed.

articleTitle: Methods of Digitalizing the Enterprises Activities in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the stages of formation and development of digital economy in Uzbekistan, as well as the problems of implementing information and communication technologies in activities of enterprises in Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: Information Retrieval of Text Analogs Based on the CLAD Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper describes the cross-language plagiarism detection method CLAD (Cross-Language Analog Detector) between the test document and indexed documents. The main difference of this method from existing versions is the detection of plagiarism among multiple languages not only two languages and checking all synonym versions of every term which using during compare documents. While translating terms, it uses the dictionary-based machine-translation method. CLAD's working process consists of document indexing and detection process phases. In this paper, we have described both of these phases.

articleTitle: Method of Information Modeling of the Phytosanitary Control Risk Management System at Checkpoints Across the Customs Border of the Republic of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the task of reengineering the process of organizing customs control of foreign trade goods and the development of the customs information system “Single Window” of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The problems of integrating this system with the Customs Risk Management System are analyzed. The concept of information modeling of the requirements of customs legislation and a description of the information model of a single document on goods based on an invoice or shipping document of foreign trade are proposed. The results of studies that allow automating the process of determining the presence of risks for phytosanitary control at the border are presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm of Numbers to Text Conversion for Uzbek Language TTS Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Numbers and counting have become an essential element of our daily living, particularly when we talk about the electronic computer. This article explains specific methods determining the Uzbek number rule and describes a computational technique able to transform decimal numbers to their equal Uzbek number names. First, we analyzed the scientific and morphological foundation of the Uzbek numbers to formalize its syntactic and arithmetic techniques. Second, a new algorithm was developed to convert numbers in the decimal number system into Uzbek words. Finally, a software tool was developed based on the proposed algorithm. This software tool is part of the software for translating Uzbek texts into speech.

articleTitle: Methodology for processing and analysis of diagnostic indicators electrocardiogram based on Labview
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases occupy an important place all over the world, which necessitates the development of more effective modern means of their diagnosis and treatment. In this regard, this article is devoted to the development of algorithms and software for processing and analysis of electrocardiograms (ECG), as well as calculating heart rate and detecting arrhythmias based on Labview. “Methods of noise removal and wavelet transform are adopted as a mathematical apparatus for processing and analyzing ECGs to eliminate baseline deviations and extract ECG signs. The main attention is paid to the organization of the ECG database, the development of algorithms for converting the ECG database file into a useful format for Labview and processing the ECG signal with the removal of noise from the original ECG signal, extracting features for obtaining diagnostic ECG indicators, calculating the heart rate and detecting arrhythmias.

articleTitle: Qualitative Analysis of the Mathematical Model of Regulatory Mechanisms of the Latent Form Hepatitis B Viruses
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Ahstract- The purpose of this article is to qualitatively analyze a mathematical model of regulatory mechanisms of liver cells in the quasi-stationary functioning of hepatitis B viruses, which represent the latent form of hepatitis B viruses. The mathematical model is in the form of a functional-differential equation with a delay argument of the Goodwin type. The qualitative analysis examined the properties of mathematical model solutions, such as the existence, continuity, non-negativity, uniqueness, and boundedness. As a result of qualitative analysis, it was found that the mathematical model reflects the normal and anomalous modes of regulatory mechanisms of liver cells in the quasi-stationary functioning of hepatitis B viruses, i.e. in dynamic chaos, black hole modes.

articleTitle: A Pipelined Processing Model of Packets in an Open Flow Switch
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The analysis of packet processing models in the flow tables of the OpenFlow switch is carried out, a model of pipelined packet processing is developed, simulation modeling of the OpenFlow switch with sequential and pipelined packet processing is carried out, the probabilistic temporal characteristics of packet servicing with Poisson and self-similar flows are determined.

articleTitle: Face Sketch Recognition Threat Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper is given forensic face sketch recognition paradigm and problems. Also, here is presented trajectory of attacker and protection way by threat model. As a result of this work is done threat model with attack points in face sketch recognition system. In table is described types of threats and protection measures from face falsification.

articleTitle: Two states uniform 2D linear cellular automata and some replicating patterns
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper has presented theoretical and imaginary investigation of 2D (two-dimensional) additive (linear) and uniform CA (cellular automata). Regarding some important properties, one can consider geometrical models of motifs (image model) generated by CA finite iterations.
