In the present paper, we study 2D linear CA under null and periodic boundary conditions over the binary or two states field ℤ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> i.e. two spin states case. It is studied the applications of replicating patterns corresponding to the uniform linear rules of 2D CA with these special boundary conditions over ℤ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. All the linear null and periodic rules can be found to be multiple replicating copies of a given image depending on the special types.

articleTitle: Analysis, research and simulation of a multiservice network based on the Packet Tracer software package to determine the value of delays to increasing value size of ICMP packet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The publication in the introduction provides a overview of sources devoted to the analysis of the configuration and technology of the multiservice network. The purpose of the study is to analyze and study, simulate of model a multiservice network on the Packet Tracer program package, which is used for transmitting information based on the OSPF routing protocol to determine the value of information for a single time when the size of the ICMP packet increases. On the developed model, which consists of the structure of Internet technologies based on IP protocol and MPLS technology, the value of the transmitted packet is changed and the value of delay in the developed model is determined. Then, after analyzing the obtained values, as a result of the experiments, the value of information for a single time is determined when the value size of ICMP packet increases.

articleTitle: The Use of Hall Converters in Flaw Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The most important task facing researchers working in the field of flaw detection is to increase the resolution of flaw detectors. One of the paramount tasks is the problem of monitoring various metal structures, welds, especially in railway transport, where defects in rail lashes can lead to accidents. Therefore, reliable flaw detection systems are very important. Most modern methods are limited in their application. So for acoustic flaw detectors, preliminary surface treatment and direct contact with the rail are necessary. Fluoroscopy is indispensable for checking thick rail lashes; the powder method is expensive. Many magnetic methods require preliminary magnetization, which is unrealistic for long rail lashes. The most suitable is the use of Hall converters. In this regard, the application of the Hall effect in flaw detection is relevant.

articleTitle: Intelligent Medical System of Designing Medical Technics and Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Investigated the principles, methods, tools and procedures of the intellectual medical system for the design of medical technics and technology. A systematic approach based on the structural-algorithmic method of constructing intelligent medical systems is proposed. The conceptual characteristics, principles, models and tools of the designed intellectual system of the biomedical object are presented, consisting in the analysis and processing of medical information of various kinds, as well as the design of medical equipment and systems including the medical technological process. The proposed method is implemented in the development of algorithms and software for processing and analyzing the characteristics of cardiovascular diseases, in particular, indicators of electrocardiograms. The proposed concept and platform is the basis of the being developed system of an integrated intellectual medical system for designing medical technics and technology in medical institutions of the healthcare system.

articleTitle: Algorithm for organizing customs control for international car transportation under remote declaration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The mechanism for monitoring the movement of foreign vehicles on the territory of the country and compliance with the requirements of customs legislation are considered in the article. An information model of requirements of regulatory legal acts and an algorithm for monitoring compliance with these requirements in the context of remote declaration of goods and quarantine have been developed. Algorithms for ensuring the completeness of customs duties by integrating interdepartmental information systems are also considered in the article.

articleTitle: Universal Linear Data Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the relevant issue of formalizing the description of a universal linear data structure. In modern programming, various data structures are described as linear data structures. The paper presents general functions for performing operations on such data structures as vector, deck, list, set and multiset. The conditions that these functions must meet are introduced as axioms. To describe the axioms, an approach based on an abstract data type, algebraic and formal grammatical approaches were used.

articleTitle: On one Method for Solving the Multi-class Classification Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers one of the main tasks of data mining the problem of pattern recognition for some classes of objects. The problem of multiclass classification was solved based on the solution of special systems of inequalities, and the corresponding algorithm for the decision rule of multiclass classification was constructed.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of the Detection System of Distributed Network Attacks Type “Denial of Service”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents a methodology and software implementation of a system designed to detect distributed network denial of service attacks. It is shown that the evaluation of the effectiveness of DDoS-attacks detection systems in computer networks and its comparative analysis with other approaches, methods and systems is a difficult task.

articleTitle: Increase Channels of Optical Networks using Nonrelation Switches
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article assumes throughput of optical networks, characteristics of random change of waiting times, the average nonzero retention time caused by fault in the optical line are the basis for minimizing the average retention of messages for optical network routing. This article suggests single-way dynamic routing method for identify part of traffics. Also presented advantages of using nonrelation switches for increasing number of channels of optical networks.

articleTitle: Magneto-Optical Waveguide Gates for Digital Logic Operations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Developed mechanisms for controlling magnetooptical qubits can be used for the various magneto-optical logic gates modeling in waveguide configuration, including implementation of the half-adder that performs parallel and simultaneous AND and XOR operations. The developed devices can be used to design a wide range of information processing and transmission devices based on new principles.

articleTitle: Methodology of the Determining for Pearson's Criterion based on Researching the Value of Delays in the Transmitting of Information over a Multiservice Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the research and statistical analysis of the distribution of delays in transmitting information over a multiservice network (MSN) based on routing protocols of the OSPF and EIGRP. The analysis based on the method of calculating the Pearson criterion, which allows us to calculate the agreement not only of the practical and theoretical values of the distribution, but also to calculate the homogeneity of two independent experimental samples. The values of delays at the nodes of transmitting information over in multiservice network using the OSPF and EIGRP protocols were taken as independent experimental samples. The results of the experiment on values of delays show that their values have a very close meaning. This is proved when calculating the Pearson's criterion, equal to 0,28%.

articleTitle: Strategy for Organization of Computational Experiments of the Functioning of Underground Water Inlets Using a Fuzzy Multiple Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article provides expert assessments of fuzzy concepts, parameters, and characteristics related to the functioning of underground water intakes (ERW). The choice and justification of the ERW technological schemes is proposed based on the analysis of lithology, thickness, width and length of aquifers, initial and boundary hydrogeological, hydrological and hydrochemical conditions. The basis of the process of justifying the ERW project is a fuzzy-deterministic model of geofiltration for a single-layer aquifer, which makes it possible to directly use in the process of modelling and PR fuzzy information expressing the experience, knowledge, intuition of hydrogeologists, presented in linguistic form. And also the article proposes an algorithm for making a decision on the formation, operation and restoration of ERW for single-layer formations.

articleTitle: Qualitative Properties of Wave Solutions of the Equation of Reaction-Diffusion of a Biological Population
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article considers systems of nonlinear reaction-diffusion models described by parabolic equations. It is shown that the models of the biological population consist in the limited nature and spatial localization of the outbreak. In the studied model, the corresponding approximations of self-similar solutions are found. The introduction of power nonlinearity in the processes of a biological population, as it turned out, in some cases leads to the same spatial dynamics as the coefficient of power nonlinearity in migration members.

articleTitle: A High Gain JFET Amplifier with Dynamic Load
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Amplifier with dynamic load is presented which ensures the increasing of the gain coefficient and excludes of distortion of the shape of output signal. Proposed effect is realized by redistribution of voltage on the dynamic resistance of transistor. There is conducted the simulation of process which confirmed the rightness of the approach.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Artificial Neural Network Training Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This study compares training algorithms for artificial neural networks such as genetic, adaptive and hybrid. The “Fisher's Irises” were used as a data for the classification problem and KNIME Analytics Platform was chosen as the experimental environment. Given results comparison analysis of three methods training for neural networks and their parameters are presented. The choice of the optimal architecture was carried out on the basis of the classification algorithm, based on the graph of classification accuracy and error.

articleTitle: Increasing the Reliability of Full Text Documents Based on the Use of Mechanisms for Extraction of Statistical and Semantic Links of Elements
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Approaches, principles and methods for increasing the reliability of information in electronic document management systems based on the use of statistical and semantic information redundancy have been developed. Methods are proposed, including mechanisms of statistical coding, extraction of statistical and semantic links, binary modular summations, and parity control. The probabilities of occurrence of single, double and t -multiple errors in texts, the required amount of information redundancy, the size of additional characters included in the information and control bits of the coding method are determined. A technique is proposed for optimizing the reliability of information based on mechanisms for coding, summing, checking, extracting statistical and semantic links of elements, as well as regulating the length of control bits. A software package for detecting and correcting one, two and t - multiple errors in the Sphinx-4 framework environment has been implemented.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Regulatory Mechanisms for the Propagation of Excitation in the Central Nervous System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents results of mathematical modeling of regulatory mechanisms of pathologies in the human nervous system responsible for acute respiratory failure in patients with COVID-19. Analysis of the characteristic behaviors of solutions of the developed functional differential equations with delay shows extinction modes, stable stationary state, stable self-oscillatory behavior, irregular functioning and the effect of sharp destructive changes - the “black hole” effect in the model of central nervous system regulation.

Index Terms: Receptors In The Central Nervous System

articleTitle: Mathematical Model Of Skin Epidermis Regulatory Mechanisms in Squamous Cell Cancers Development
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the regulatory mechanisms dynamics of skin carcinoma on the basis of the firmly established facts and theoretical positions in the field of biology, biophysics and regulation. The developed equations for the regulatory mechanisms of skin cells transformation into abnormal cancer cells have a functional-differential type. Implementation of the developed equations for the epidermis cellular communities number regulation in squamous cell carcinoma on a computer and a series of computational experiments have shown that these equations have stable stationary, self-oscillating solutions typical for the normal functioning of the skin; have chaotic solutions and the “black hole” effect, which makes it possible to diagnose the onset of the phase of unpredictable changes in the skin epidermis regulation and the beginning of the transition into tumor cells. Mathematical and computer models of the skin epidermis regulation at the norm and at the tumor process can be used to improve the methods of early diagnosis, prevention of skin diseases, as well as to choose treatment tactics.

articleTitle: The Methods, Benefits and Problems of The Interpretation of Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Data analysis and interpretation have now taken center stage with the advent of the digital age and the sheer amount of data can be frightening. In fact, a Digital Universe study found that the total data supply in 2012 was 2.8 trillion gigabytes! Based on that amount of data alone, it is clear the calling card of any successful enterprise in today's global world will be the ability to analyze complex data, produce actionable insights and adapt to new market needs all at the speed of thought. Business dashboards are the digital age tools for big data. Capable of displaying key performance indicators (KPIs) for both quantitative and qualitative data analyses, they are ideal for making the fast-paced and data-driven market decisions that push today's industry leaders to sustainable success. Through the art of streamlined visual communication, data dashboards permit businesses to engage in real-time and informed decision making, and are key instruments in data interpretation. This research article based on methods, benefits and problems of the interpretation of data.

articleTitle: Development of A Model of Multifunctional Earth Soil Pre-Destruction System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Monitoring the displacement of the earth's soil is important for tracking the dynamics of the landslide process, the tendency of its continuous development and developing of measures to mitigate the negative impact. Utilizing of this technology is not widely spread because of its high cost, as well as demand for integrating numerous additional sensors to track factors and control the movement of landslides. In order to solve these problems, we have developed a remote monitoring system for the pre-destruction of the earth's soil based on a fiber-optic sensor and a moisture sensor. The system registers certain parameters, functions as a ground displacement detector, also transmits data to the server (Observation Center).

articleTitle: About Mutual Impact Of LTE and DVB Networks In the 790 … 862 MHz Band In The Republic Of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The deployment of new mobile services in the 790 ... 862 MHz band introduces the risk of potential interference to digital terrestrial television receiving equipment. For this reason it is necessary to study coexistence issues between the uppermost TV channels (51...60 CH) and emissions from LTE base stations in the band 791...821 MHz.

articleTitle: Overlay Networking Issues: Implementation The Functional Components
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The success of the Internet is determined mainly due to interoperability supported by IP protocol and the presence of the end-to-end connection principle, which has long been the foundation of the Internet architecture. However, this has also caused serious problems: heterogeneous services, new needs and requirements (real-time support of services, increased security), complexity and scalability problems (arising from the enormous scale of the modern Internet, measured in terms of traffic and connection (links)). One of the solutions to such problems in the modern architecture of the Internet relates with the approaches based on virtual overlay networks. An important issue is the need to develop models for the appropriate mapping of the functionality of overlay networks, taking into account the requirements of various parties.

articleTitle: Formalization of Data Derivative Structures
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the topical issue of formal description of data structures. Data structures are widely used in modern object-oriented programming to solve various practical problems. The paper introduces functions for performing operations with such data structures as stack, queue, and priority queue. The conditions that these functions must satisfy are introduced as axioms. To describe the axioms, an approach based on an abstract data type, algebraic and programmatic approaches were used.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Adaptive-fuzzy System Regulating the Temperature of Overheated Steam in Heat-electric Objects
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the results of developing an algorithm for calculating the parameters of an adaptive controller when controlling the temperature of superheated steam. The presented control algorithm uses artificial neural networks. The purpose of this scientific work is to develop adaptive control capable of operating under unknown limited external disturbances with varying parameters of the thermoelectric boiler over time. Research methods are based on the provisions of modern areas of control theory, such as adaptive management and identification. Mathematical models are constructed by the analytical method using equations that describe the physical properties of the object. The methodology of creating a temperature control system for a superheater operating under conditions of a priori uncertainty is presented. It is shown that such control systems belong to adaptive systems capable of controlling an object with significant and previously unknown object parameters. It is proposed to use an artificial neuron as an adaptive part of a control system or their combination - artificial neural networks.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology for Effective Teaching of the Subject “Data Structure and Algorithms” Through Innovative Master-Trainings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, a methodology for effective teaching of lectures on information technology through master classes has been developed. The selected topic “static and dynamic data structures” of subject of “data structure and algorithms” was used as an example, using the method of “fish skeleton”, which is one of the modern pedagogical technologies. As a result, students gained a deeper understanding of the essence of the topic.

Author Keywords: improving the professional competence of teachers through training

articleTitle: Development Of A Model For Calculating The Probability Of Timely Delivery Of Packages In IMS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The imitative model is developed for research of probability of timely delivery of packets in IMS -networks, histograms of allocation of a time delay of packets in a network are received, approximation of the received histograms by means of various allocations is led, the empirical formula for calculation of probability of timely delivery on the basis of gamma allocation is offered.

Author Keywords: probability of timely delivery of packets
coefficient of a variation of a time delay of packets
the histogram of delay period of packets

articleTitle: Educational and research competencies in the training of the course “Discrete mathematics” for training bachelors in computer engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper we consider the control problem of ensemble of trajectories for one In recent years, the importance of discrete mathematics has increased dramatically. This is not the name of a branch of mathematics such as number theory, algebra, calculus. This is a separate branch of knowledge, which is called “discrete” (individual). However, there are also processes of continuous mathematics, that is, it becomes a continuous whole. Discrete data can only take integer values, while continuous data can take any value. Discrete mathematics was created several decades ago and is the mathematical language of computer science. Scientists have found that the mathematical disciplines taught in universities are insufficient for learning a programming language. Therefore, they combine additional maths topics into one course, now called discrete mathematics. Discrete mathematics is the foundation of computer science and theoretical computer science. Without learning discrete mathematics, we miss the essence of the logic of computer science. Due to the multiplicity of objects within discrete mathematics, rational clarity in solving programming issues is possible. Every field in computer science is associated with discrete objects, be it databases, network components, computer organization, compilers, network programming, and so on. Essentially, discrete mathematics studies the concepts of counting, mathematical structures, logic, recursion, computational modeling, graph theory and algorithms, and many other disciplines. Evidence, a basic concept in discrete mathematics that includes deductive thinking, simplification, pattern identification, mathematical notation, working within constraints and conditions. This does not mean that a formal course in discrete mathematics is necessary or should be required for programmers. However, many of the concepts discussed in discrete mathematics are applied using this science. In this article, we will look at the basic postulates of discrete mathematics that are necessary to learn the basics of programming.

articleTitle: Development of a Modern Corpus of Computational Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is dedicated to theoretical and practical issues that arose during the creation of corpus for Uzbek language. Foreign experience and software have been investigated while creating the corpus of the Uzbek language. The modern corpus will be designed and developed in the Uzbek language as a balanced, large-scale and universal corpus. The theoretical and practical methods have been studied before the creation of the corpus are. Throughout the process, different softwares have been used to solve specific problems and The created corpus will be an open source for non-commercial use. The article describes the initial stages of the structure of the corpus and the requirements for the creation of modern corpus.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of a Nonlinear Heat Conduction Process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents the results of numerical modeling of a nonlinear heat conduction process using explicit and implicit conservative difference schemes, as well as various methods for calculating the value of the heat conductivity coefficient, which is a power-law function of temperature.

Author Keywords: explicit and implicit conservative difference schemes

articleTitle: Analysis of Subject Recognition Algorithms based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes the principles of construction, training and use of neural networks. The features of the neural network approach are indicated, as well as the range of tasks for which it is most preferable. Algorithms of functioning, software implementation and results of work of an artificial neural network are presented.

articleTitle: Dynamic control in Fog Computing infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the Internet of Things era, a big volume of data is generated/gathered every second from billions of connected devices. The current network paradigm, which relies on centralised data centres (Cloud computing), becomes an impractical solution for IoT data storing and processing due to the long distance between the data source (e.g., sensors) and designated data centres. It worth noting that the long distance in this context refers to the physical path and time interval of when data is generated and when it get processed. To explain more, by the time the data reaches a far data centre, the importance of the data can be depreciated. Therefore, the network topologies have evolved to permit data processing and storage at the edge of the network, introducing what so-called fog Computing. The later will obviously lead to improvements in quality of service via processing and responding quickly and efficiently to varieties of data processing requests. In this paper, Fog Resource manAgeMEnt Scheme (FRAMES) has been proposed to crystallise fog distribution and management with an appropriate service load distribution and allocation.

articleTitle: Conceptual model of the Hall effect for the development of current converters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes certain types of the Hall effect using a conceptual model, which was used as an energy-information model of circuits (EIMC), based on the theory of analogy and similarity, which allows describing processes and phenomena of various physical nature using a single mathematical apparatus and parametric structural scheme (PSS).

Author Keywords: Bank of physical and technical effects (PhTE)

articleTitle: Multi-stream routing of packets of heterogeneous traffic in software-defined networking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article proposes to organize the transmission of packets of heterogeneous traffic at the infrastructure level of a software-defined networking based on multi-path routing, the essence of which is to determine the shortest route for each type of external traffic separately and to transmit packet flows along a priori calculated shortest paths.

articleTitle: The Research Mathematical Model of the Three-impulse System of Automatic Control of steam Generator Water Supply on Load Relief
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper of a typical three-pulse automatic control system (ACS) of water supply to a steam generator is analyzed. A mathematical model has been developed for testing its operability for load shedding, which makes it possible to establish the maximum deviations of the water level without carrying out field tests, without adjusting the operating settings of technological protections according to the water level in the drum. The reasons for static control errors during the development of internal and external disturbances on the consumption of superheated steam in a typical ACS are determined. The relevance of modernization of a typical ACS for water supply to a steam generator is determined.

articleTitle: Designing client-server and service oriented architecture of the distance learning system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Advancement of information and communication technologies crossed the boundaries of different fields and converged them for making traditional services easier for consumption and delivery. Considering pandemic period in entire world education sector offered online and distance learning systems for keeping educational processes going on. Regarding the abovementioned motivational factors, this paper is devoted to the designing of distance learning information system which is very crucial for the development and timely delivery of educational services to the learners. Three layered client-server architecture and service oriented architecture of the e-LMS distance learning systems have been suggested considering the processes and aspects of education system of Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: 2D periodic CA rules over $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ and applications of image processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This work deals with the theory 2-dimensional (2D), uniform periodic boundary replications cellular automata (2D PB CA) of linear rules with applications of image processing science. We investigate a 2D CA with PB over the binary field ℤ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> case, i.e. 2-state spin case. It is also studied image applications corresponding for the linear (additive) rules of uniform 2D CA PB over binary field (two-states) ℤ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Analysis problems digitalization of the activities of Uzbekistan banks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, an analysis of the digitalization of the activity of the banks of the republic is considered. Analysis of monitoring during the period of 2015-2019 showed the differently assigned trends in the rating of the introduction of ICT in the activities of banks. Measures are proposed for the wider development of digitalization in the bank.

articleTitle: Problems and criteria for controlling the reliability of customs information in the conditions of remote declaration of goods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the task of modeling the process of remote declaration of goods in a global pandemic and the criteria for monitoring the reliability of customs information. The information contained in the cargo customs declarations submitted to the customs authorities remotely in digital format was considered as the main object of the study. The technique of information modeling of the process using a multidimensional information matrix is proposed. Criteria for verifying the reliability of these cargo customs declarations are given that are related to ensuring the completeness of customs payments.

Author Keywords: remote declaration of goods in a pandemic

articleTitle: Electrical Properties and Photosensitivity of Multi-Barrier Photodiode Structure Based on Semi-Insulating GaAs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The present work reports the detailed electrical properties and photosensitivity of multi-barrier photodiode structures based on semi-insulating gallium arsenide. The dependence of the dark current on the voltage is linear up to 70 V when p-n-junction is reverse biased, and is linear up to 300 V when one is forward biased. The structure has a high sensitivity in the region of wavelength which are larger than the red border, determined by the band gap of the base region material. The photosensitivity of the structure corresponds to the photoemission of non-equilibrium charge carriers through a metal-semiconductor rectifying barrier.

articleTitle: Expert system with Fuzzy logic for protecting Scientific Information Resources
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Analysis of the state of development of research on the protection of valuable scientific and educational databases, library resources, information centers, publishers show the importance of information security, especially in corporate information networks and systems for data exchange. Corporate library networks include dozens and even hundreds of libraries for active information exchange, and they (libraries) are equipped with information security tools to varying degrees. The purpose of the research is to create effective methods and tools to protect the databases of the scientific and educational resources from unauthorized access in libraries and library networks using fuzzy logic methods.

articleTitle: Models and algorithms for the optimal processing of spatio-temporal signals by the method of fractal
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article deals with the problems of optimal radio reception on the basis of mathematical models, signal display, signal differentiation, signal parameter evaluation and filtering of messages.

articleTitle: Study of Efficiency of Functioning of Traffic Management Algorithms in Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose using the power criterion, known in the control theory as the sensitivity of the system, to evaluate the efficiency of the functioning of various traffic management methods in networks and the influence of the main system parameters on the characteristics. Numerical calculations of link models and network packet transport network according to the sensitivity criterion were conducted. The proposed sensitivity analysis method can be used in network synthesis problems to select the best option, when the design results in several network options that are quite close in their characteristics.

articleTitle: Selection of Optimal Methods in Decision Making to Properly Assess the Situation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to a review of the methods for assessing the state of a system operating in both quantitative and variable environments. It is explained that these methods can be used in non-quantitative and quantitative data processing systems. It is said that one of the statistical methods of filtering the system status assessment problem can be solved through the Kalman filter. And conversely, the idea of creating a linguistic model for non-quantitative data is given. The article also discusses pattern detection technology, another system condition assessment method. Advantages using the pattern detection method were considered. In conclusion, ideas on which of these methods would be most effective are given.

articleTitle: Numerical Methods for Solving the Two-Dimensional Boundary Value Problem of the Elasticity Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Using the theory of elasticity and thermoelasticity of the space of deformations, coupled boundary-value problems are formulated. The theory of elasticity and thermoelasticity of the deformation space, unlike the existing one, allows us to formulate conjugate boundary-value problems for increments of displacement and temperature. Explicit and implicit finite-difference equations are constructed for the two - dimensional case of boundary value problems. The numerical solution of explicit finite-difference equations reduces to the use of recurrence formulas, while the implicit scheme reduces to the use of the elimination method.

articleTitle: On the Problem of Controllability an Ensemble of Trajectories for One Information Model of Dynamic System with Delay
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper we consider the control problem of ensemble of trajectories for one information model of dynamic system controlled differential inclusion with a delayed argument. The controllability conditions for the ensemble of trajectories from the initial state to a given terminal set are studied. Necessary and sufficient conditions for (φ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>, Y)-controllability are given. The results are obtained by methods of the theory of differential inclusions and multi-valued analysis.

articleTitle: Industry Digitalization Consepts with 5G-based IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Recent developments in wireless technology and computing have given rise to two new and promising perspectives: the fifth generation (5G) wireless network and Internet of Things (IoT). If we take a closer look at these technologies, they together play an important role in the digitalization of industry and the design of smart industries. This article provides information on the key potentials and concepts of the 5G-based digitization industry, as well as the relevant usage conditions and requirements. In addition, the article presents some of the key blocks of 5G and some important issues that have not yet been resolved and their solutions.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Electromagnetic Compatibility in Design of Radio Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis of electromagnetic compatibility issues inside radio electronic equipment. Creating a new component base, the emergence of new materials and technologies requires an integrated approach in dealing with electromagnetic compatibility issues. Methods and approaches for designing modern wireless communication systems are considered.

articleTitle: Systems and Technologies for Remote Health State Monitoring of Patients with Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The system structure and method for long-term continuous monitoring and control of patient's health state are considered. In order to build such systems and provide biomedical research outside of a medical institution the following problems have to be solved: to form a complex of diagnostically significant indicators for health state abnormality detection; to develop methods of biomedical signals acquisition at patient's vital activity as well as algorithms of signals processing and indicators assessment. It is shown that these systems should operate in the intelligent monitoring mode. It involves a change in the number of active channels for picking up and recording of biomedical signals, and their characteristics, the number of signs used to identify episodes of exacerbation of a chronic disease, when diagnostically significant indicators of the disease go beyond the patient's individual norm.

articleTitle: Models and algorithms for solving problems associated with large amounts of data in the military sphere
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article provides an overview of the development, characteristics and application of Big Data technologies, and also discusses, analyzes what Big Data is, its implementation in the military sphere, the current state of affairs, possible solutions to problems, limitations that prevent it from being done effectively also provides an overview three modern approaches to working with big data: NoSQL, MapReduce and processing of streams of events in real-time and development prospects.

articleTitle: Sales Forecasting for Fresh Foods: A study in Indonesian FMCG
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This study aims to get the accurate bread demand forecasting method in one of the major bread producers in Indonesia. Given the many types of bread sold, this study is limited to five types of products. Using several time-series forecasting methods used, including the moving average method, the exponential smoothing method, multiple regression methods, and the SVR method (Support Vector Regression). Forecasting bread sales using the best method, which is the method that produces the smallest error value. Forecasting error methods used are the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD), and Mean Squared Error (MSE). The results show that to produce high forecasting accuracy, the forecasting method must be supported by the data mining process. This research empirically proves that store classification combined with seasonal factors such as weekends, holidays, and pay periods have an influence on forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Cloud and Fog Computing: Challenging Issues for Internet of Things and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the need for state-of-the-art trend in distributed computing - Fog computing as well as its distinctions in terms of an architecture and technical aspects with cloud computing followed by prerequisites to Fog platform so as to be able to deal with real-time Big Data obtained from evolving Internet of Things/Everything devices and wireless sensor networks. Fog computing is arguably either a virtualized platform or real equipment typically located between end user devices and the cloud data centres hosted within the Internet. As compared to Cloud computing, it has a number of distinctions such as low latency, low jitter, the location of fog nodes at the edge of the local network, one-hop distance between the client and the server, a tremendous number of server nodes distributed geographically, the support of mobility along with real-time interactions, etc.

articleTitle: Development of Energy-Efficient LEACH Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: With the Current and latest developments in communications integrated with the WSN building resources and multi objective optimization often rise energy conservation and load optimization. To identify WSN building resource optimization problems relating to wireless sensor network design, routing, energy conservative method in deployment, multi objective optimization. We review building methodology and cluster gateway with different desirable objectives to show load calculation mechanism. We proposed building methodology of clustering, Gateway discovery process, load calculation and load migration related to wireless sensor network which consists of input variables, required output, objectives and constraints. The distribution of the traffic throughout the cluster such as optimization decision will implement the cluster gateway and result will be analyzed. The various constraints in load optimization which are following while implementing the load optimization issues in wireless sensor networks. Considering the heterogeneous network with cluster based load distribution approach by broadcasting a periodic gateway transmission between cluster nodes, this will create new avenues of research in the area of multi-objective optimization relating to wireless sensor networks. Cluster based wireless sensor network protocol (CBWSN) developed according to LEACH protocol.

articleTitle: Hiding Short Message Text In the Uzbek Language
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Steganography is a method that is based on hiding or embedding additional information in digital objects while causing some distortion of these objects. In this case, an object or container can be used image, audio, video, network packets, etc. Recently, there have been a lot of publications in the field of hiding information in a text container. To embed a secret, steganographic methods rely on redundant information about the covering medium used or properties that the human perception system cannot distinguish. Since text documents are widely used in organizations, using a text document as a storage medium may be the preferred choice in such an environment, while having little excess information. Therefore, the choice of using a text document as a storage medium is the most difficult, since it contains less redundant information. In this article, we present a simple and new approach to steganography based on the Uzbek language. We analyze the characteristics of the Uzbek language and offer some effective methods for converting messages to bits. We find that a single Uzbek text message can be converted to multiple secret bits. The results show that the proposed method is very important for a successful steganographic technique. Besides, we find that embedded bits can be correctly and easily extracted by human observers without using a special decoder. Thus, the proposed scheme is practical and effective for hiding messages and is a new approach for the Uzbek language.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Flooding Algorithm for Wireless Nanosensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The next step of technological evolution will be the advances in the nanotechnology, in other words, designing very small systems that can perform commands of people. Nanotechnology lets manipulating individual atoms or molecules of the matter and construct novel materials that could be used in designing new tools that simplifies human life. The theory and practice of designing the communication among nanoscale objects and formation of nanosensor networks draw attention of the scientific community in recent years. A nanosensor network is a new paradigm that allows nanomachines to connect each other using certain methods of communication mechanisms. This paper includes electromagnetic-based wireless nanosensor networks that formation and simulation methods are already suggested in many papers. Generally, the use of simple flooding in any network is the cause of excess rebroadcasts and collisions. Ultimately, existing these issues, decrease quality of service of a network, especially in context of energy consumption. In this paper, we worked on elimination of above-mentioned issues in wireless nanosensor networks by using counter-based scheme, wherein, average network throughput and latency rates got satisfactory marks. We have adapted counter-base scheme in context of wireless nanosensor networks and named it Efficient Flooding Algorithm. Simulations have been conducted in network simulator 3 and results show that the use of enhanced flooding outperforms the simple flooding mechanism.

articleTitle: Effective recognition of pollen grains based on parametric adaptation of the image identification model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Constructive approaches, principles and methods of image processing in conditions of a priori insufficiency, parametric uncertainty, low accuracy of information have been developed on the basis of statistical, dynamic, neural network models for identifying micro-objects. Methods of point and nonlinear verification of the correspondence of the contours of the input and reference objects based on the selection, segmentation, interpolation of specific characteristics of images of pollen grains and regulation of raster parameters are proposed. Modified computational schemes for learning neural networks with forward and backward propagation of errors, regulation of interneural connections in layers, neuron weights, variable activation functions, network architecture, training samples, superposition of continuous input-output dependencies. A computer complex for identification in the C++ language in the “CUDA” parallel computing environment has been implemented for the recognition, classification and systematization of pollen grains [1].

articleTitle: Ground and confined underground waters and their salt content
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A article developed a mathematical model for monitoring and predicting changes in groundwater level and salt concentration, as well as for representing the process of flooding, salinization and waterlogging in the design of hydraulic structures. A qualitative analysis of the research work on this issue is presented. Since the process is represented by a nonlinear differential equation, a numerical algorithm based on finite-difference schemes was developed to solve it. Mathematical models of the processes of geofiltration of salt migration have been improved and computational algorithms have been developed. A numerical algorithm has been developed for calculating the problem of changing the groundwater level, taking into account active porosity, flow rate in two-layer formations

articleTitle: Development and research of a codec based on a high-precision iterative algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, for the practical implementation of methods and algorithms of high-precision iterative, a codec based on a programmable logic integrated circuit has been developed, which can be used for coding and high-precision iterative decoding block, convolutional and compositional codes in digital television systems, digital data transmission and satellite communications. The model makes it possible to construct the probabilistic-energy characteristics of high-precision iterative codes with their various code constructions, conducts research and analysis to determine the efficiency and basic properties of these codes. A new method for compositional coding of high-precision iterative codes (compositional code) has been developed.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance Efficiency of Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The process of evaluating the performance efficiency of wireless sensor networks is discussed in the article. The main groups of functions of performance efficiency indicators such as monitoring (coverage), telecommunications and energy saving and performance stages are identified. Analytical models for evaluating the performance parameters of wireless sensor networks for each functional subsystem of the network management system and the network as a whole are proposed. Energy efficiency indicators were analyzed and the lifetime of the network and nodes was determined. The calculation of the average power consumption for the node is given. Indicators of network life based on the size and type of coverage area of the network, indicators based on the time of performance of tasks at different stages of the network, indicators of the telecommunications subsystem and integrated indicators are given.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Cross-Systems of Numerical Simulation of Diffusion Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article describes the methods of numerical simulation of mutual reaction-diffusion systems with double nonlinearity in multicomponent media, development of software packages. To obtain estimates of the free boundary for systems of reaction-diffusion with double nonlinearity. Development of numerical schemes of algorithms and software complexes for these problems in the multidimensional case. To investigate the properties of the finite velocity of perturbation propagation and spatial localization for a nonlinear model of polytropic filtration with double nonlinearity. To investigate the asymptotics of self-similar polytropic filtration systems in two-component media with a source. The object of research is the qualitative properties of solutions of polytropical filtration systems in a two-component medium with non-local boundary conditions. In the article uses the nonlinear splitting algorithm, the method of reference equations, the method of comparing solutions, iterative numerical methods, methods of variable directions and runs.
